card.name: Scattered words before a phrase boundary
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on unrelated words such as 'day' in 'business day', 'without' before 'warning symptoms', and the colon after 'Reviewer'.

modes.label: Without before warning signs
modes.description: The word 'without' in a sentence saying serious harm can occur without warning symptoms.
modes.example: renal injury can occur<< without>> warning symptoms or signs, consider monitoring patients

modes.label: Reviewer credit colon
modes.description: The colon after 'Reviewer' just before a reviewer's name at the end of a web health article.

modes.label: Time unit in service text
modes.description: The word 'day' or 'hour' in website phrases about time, such as business days or 24 hours.
modes.example: A member of our team will call you back within one business<< day>>.

card.plain: Nothing in common was found across the passages; it responds to a mix of unrelated words and shows no pattern a clinician could use.
